children: announced voting results from its first Annual Meeting of Stockholders, held virtually Aug. 31, 2026. Shareholders approved the company pursuit of a reverse stock split, valid for 12 months and to be used only if the board determines it is necessary to meet minimum bid-price requirements for an uplisting to a national securities exchange. Shareholders also authorized the board independent Special Committee to negotiate the retirement of the Series B Preferred Stock, which the company said would eliminate its dual-class, super-voting control structure.

Shareholders also approved the company cash-only “Say-on-Pay” executive compensation structure and elected a three-year review cycle, re-elected all seven director nominees and ratified Semple, Marchal & Cooper, LLP as the independent registered public accounting firm. Earth Science Tech said an audio replay of the meeting includes management guidance, additional detail on the approved proposals and a shareholder question-and-answer session.
To view the full press release, visit https://ibn.fm/KCU5p

Earth Science Tech, Inc. operates as a diversified holding company focused on the health and wellness sector. The Company’s principal operating strategy is to build a vertically integrated healthcare platform that combines compounding pharmacy operations, telemedicine platforms, clinical support, and direct-to-patient fulfillment. The Company’s healthcare operations are supported by investments in real estate and asset management activities and a consumer products business.
The core of the Company’s value proposition is the seamless integration of patient care, from consultation to fulfillment. This is achieved through the synergy of specialized subsidiaries.
The latest news and updates relating to ETST are available in the company’s newsroom at https://ibn.fm/ETST
